spec.baseline: Zero cash/no-trade gross return; always-long fixed 10,000 AUD gross price exposure is context only.

costs.explanation: Gross quote changes only; a zero here is NOT a claim that real perpetual funding, spread, fees, or impact are zero.

evaluation.diagnostic: 119 calendar-month starting intervals from 2015-01 through 2024-11 are eligible in principle. Report exclusions and contiguous month coverage, direction counts/episodes, mean USD/month and bps relative to USD 100,000, six-month moving-block bootstrap CI, hit rate, always-long comparator and predeclared 2015-2019 / 2020-2024 splits. Diagnose only; no Engine or executable fill simulation.
evaluation.limit: No historical AUDUSD perpetual on Hyperliquid; old FX quote prices are not perpetual returns. Neither perp funding nor executable bid/ask/commission/slippage is included in gross signal results.
evaluation.macro_alignment: At the first observed FX weekday 10:00 New York per month, select official RBA/Fed effective levels dated at or before 16:00 New York of the preceding completed observed FX session. For the historical decisions, RBA published 14:30 Sydney the previous day, and the Federal Reserve published its rate decisions before the corresponding US-session 16:00 cutoff. Exact archival release-time verification remains unqualified and limits interpretation.
evaluation.macro_sources: RBA cash-rate official effective-date decision table, Fed DFEDTARU effective date from Federal Reserve via FRED
evaluation.mode: MVP Research - gross price-only Phase 3 diagnostic
evaluation.monthly_clock: Decision at NY 10:00, next-bar 10:01 quote open is the gross-price outcome entry proxy. Real 09:59, 10:00, and 10:01 UTC-tagged source minute bars required; first eligible weekday in each month. Next monthly 10:01 quote open ends the label. No same-bar signal price, weekend price, or missing-price fill.
evaluation.sizing: Target sign times 10,000 AUD units, unchanged if sign persists; gross monthly price PnL USD = target_AUD * (next_quote_open - quote_open).
evaluation.source: London Strategic Edge AUDUSD 1m current canonical metadata
evaluation.trial_budget: one predeclared price-direction screen; no variant search

spec.falsifier: Phase 3 proxy PASS requires >=96 complete consecutive-eligible monthly intervals across >=8 calendar years, >=12 long and >=12 short months, >=4 signed exposure episodes, mean gross fixed-AUD monthly USD PnL >0, and strictly positive 95% lower bound using a predeclared six-month moving-block bootstrap (seed=7, 5000 resamples). FAIL only if the upper 95% CI is below zero with qualified coverage. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. A proxy PASS never implies executable perpetual net return or FINAL VALIDATE. Do not optimize sign, month, cutoff, or horizon.

instruments.identity: forex_minute_AUDUSD provider=london_strategic_edge 1m historical quote-OHLC research proxy, USD per AUD, no bid/ask or perp funding. Live Hyperliquid perpDexs/meta inspection found no AUDUSD perpetual.
instruments.session: FX Monday-Friday observed NY local 10:00-10:01 quote availability
instruments.venue: London Strategic Edge historical AUD/USD price feed; not an executable perpetual book

spec.mechanism: Monetary-policy relative stance might correlate with medium-horizon currency repricing and risk sentiment. This is a PRICE-DIRECTION hypothesis and is not a currency-forward carry premium replication: net retail FX swap or perpetual funding can have either sign.
spec.thesis: In development years 2015-2024, fixed 10,000-AUD notional monthly directional AUDUSD price changes selected by the prior-known sign of RBA cash-rate target minus Fed target upper limit have positive mean gross USD price PnL versus no-trade cash, without assuming any carry credit.

trials.description: Single frozen 2015-2024 AUDUSD macro-rate spread sign monthly gross-price effect and 6-month block-bootstrap uncertainty, with no unknown financing imputed and no protected holdout access.
